game.name: PokeMMO
game.desc: Unofficial port of PokeMMO for PortMaster-compatible devices. PokeMMO is a fan-made multiplayer online game that brings together various Pokémon generations in a single MMO experience. Includes a launcher menu to download/update the official client, console, small and Android UI modes, a joystick mapper and shaders optimized for low-end GPUs.
